A true castle transformed into an exclusive boutique hotel in the heart of Santiago
A castle to call home. It’s not just a hotel in Santiago.
It’s an authentic castle where traditional architecture blends with exclusive design and the utmost in contemporary comfort. All stays include breakfast, carefully prepared so you can start your day enjoying the best of Santiago.
31 unique rooms, conceived by the Grisanti & Cussen studio, along with elegant spaces designed for relaxation and unwinding, create an intimate, sophisticated, and deeply welcoming experience.
Here, history surrounds you. The design inspires you. And every stay becomes an unforgettable memory.
Recognized among the best hotels in Santiago
Castillo Rojo has been ranked among the Top 3 hotels in Santiago on TripAdvisor and recommended by The New York Times as one of the city’s must-visit destinations. An international recognition that reinforces our excellence and distinctive boutique experience.

Boutique hotel in Providencia with a Strategic Location
Castillo Rojo is located in the heart of Santiago, offering excellent connectivity. Just 30 minutes from Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport and only 2 minutes from major highways such as Costanera Norte, our hotel provides easy access to every corner of the city.
We are also just one hour from the main ski resorts and an hour and a half from the coast and some of Chile’s most renowned vineyards, making us the ideal starting point to explore the country.

Hotel in Bellavista, Santiago, Steps from the City’s Main Attractions
Located in the bohemian neighborhood of Bellavista, our boutique hotel in Santiago is surrounded by renowned restaurants, bars, cultural venues, and vibrant nightlife.
Just a 3-minute walk away, you’ll find Pablo Neruda’s House Museum (La Chascona), Patio Bellavista, and the new Terrazas de San Cristóbal. In addition, the entrance to Parque Metropolitano and Cerro San Cristóbal is literally just steps from the hotel.
Here, you can experience Santiago on foot.
Frequently asked questions about our boutique hotel in Santiago
How far is the airport from the hotel?
Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport is approximately 20 km away, about a 30–40 minute drive.
Is it easy to access public transportation from the hotel?
Yes, Baquedano metro station is about a 10-minute walk away, connecting to the main lines across Santiago.
Is the hotel suitable for families with children?
Is the hotel suitable for families with children?
Yes, we offer double and family rooms for up to 4 guests, ideal for those traveling with children.
Does the building have an elevator?
No, as it is a historic heritage building from 1923, it cannot be modified.
Is smoking allowed inside the hotel?
No, the hotel is 100% smoke-free. Smoking is only permitted in the outdoor garden.
What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in starts at 3:00 PM and check-out is until 12:00 PM.
Is the building really a castle?
Yes, the hotel was built in 1923 and is an architectural icon of Santiago. After a careful restoration in 2010, it preserves the original charm of the 1920s while offering all modern comforts.
Do you allow pets?
No, the hotel does not allow pets, in order to ensure the comfort and tranquility of all guests.

History - Castillo Rojo Hotel Boutique
Skip to content
Menu
Book now
HISTORY
Hotel Boutique Castillo Rojo is an exclusive luxury hotel, located in the very center of Plaza Mori, in the heart of the Bellavista neighborhood, famous for its live music, theaters, restaurants and lively nightlife.
The hotel is located one block from the Pablo Neruda House (La Chascona), Patio Bellavista, the funicular that takes you to the top of Cerro San Cristobal, minutes walk from the Baquedano subway, downtown, the Fine Arts Museum and the Central Market, and only 20 minutes from the international airport.
From here, you can visit the tourist cities of Viña del Mar and Valparaíso, as well as the vineyards, which are located in the Casablanca and Maipo Valleys, just an hour and a half from the hotel, as well as ski resorts half an hour from the hotel.
The iconic Castillo Rojo was originally built in 1923 by the aristocratic Lehuedé family (you can see photos in the hallways, including the owners wedding, held in the castle itself). Later a Russian writer bought it and when he died he left it to his housekeeper, who, unable to pay all the expenses, rented it for pieces, which served as a meeting place for artists, both Chilean and foreign.
In 2010 the current owners bought it, and the remodeling and restoration took 3 years. Opened in May 2014 as a Boutique Hotel, with original furniture from those times, fireplaces and restored woodwork, with lighting and design elements typical of the style of the 1920s.
Themed rooms, most of them with decorations from the former house, for example the kitchen, the game room, etc.
Decorated by the Grisanti Cussen studio.
Hotel Boutique Castillo Rojo features 31 thoughtfully designed rooms in Classic, Queen, Suite, and Premium categories, including our new Premium Double Queen rooms, which accommodate up to 4 guests — ideal for families and groups of friends seeking more space and comfort.
Each room preserves the elegance of our historic 1920s building, while incorporating modern comforts such as air conditioning, private bathroom, high-speed Wi-Fi, 500-thread-count linens, and breakfast included. The hotel also offers private parking, subject to availability. Some rooms include a balcony, patio, or accessible features, ensuring a comfortable and memorable stay for all our guests.
It also has a Lounge and Bistro Restaurant.
We invite you to step back in time to experience the elegant style of 1920 s Santiago.
